source.qualification: File hashes were retained under the manual edit claims. The recorded HEAD is retention-time context; this is a working-source verification, not an immutable shipped build.

implementation.sharedCompilerOptions: Production builder and served prebundle rebuilder use the same serverRuntimeSpecs/serverRuntimeArgs.
implementation.immutableBuildJoin: Build snapshots Node executable/runtime, esbuild/Next files, lockfile and hashed selected settings before compilation; refuses detected environment drift before copy. Copy supplies the record to publication; publisher validates both copied package/bundle hashes and source-root identity before making the release visible.
implementation.servedJoin: Captured HTML identity -> exact immutable release metadata -> retained root custody and copied prebundle hashes -> actual esbuild stdout byte equality for the two consumed cones.
implementation.runtimeJoin: An optional explicit local Linux {pid,origin} selector must execute an entry within the chosen immutable release and own the requested listener. The guard measures executable/entry hashes, PID/startTicks and hashed selected initial settings; it rechecks process identity/cwd/argv/executable link. The runner PID cannot substitute.
implementation.environmentScope: Selected initial process settings from /proc are separate from runner settings, and exclude credentials and later in-process overrides. Missing selector remains explicitly unmeasured; unsupported platforms are refused when a selector is supplied.
implementation.wiring: All four existing hosted utility receipt paths use the build custody and optional runtime selector.
